notes.title: The Easter update!
notes.content:
[h1]Easter theme![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830981/191da42e585a269fe3d603d9e04f126a675c39aa.png[/img]
Enjoy all the maps being christmas-themed, for as long as the “Christmas” event lasts!
Collect chocolate eggs to gain HP and more boosts and XP!

[h2]New features[/h2]
[h3]Free cosmetic![/h3]
Unlock the easter egg wheels for free by completing a challenge, and keep them forever! But beware you can only unlock this for the duration of the Easter event!
You will also unlock an achievement for unlocking the wheels!

[h3]Double XP[/h3]
For the duration of any event, there are double XP rewards! Hop in and grind for those level rewa	rds!
[h3]Visual overhaul![/h3]
Enjoy the game looking clearer than ever! And with many Easter related decorations!
[h3]New cosmetics[/h3]
Check out the store for a bunch of new cosmetics and a new bundle!
The Easter bundle will be available at all times for the duration of the Easter event!

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
Made bundles cycle more random.

[h3]Join us on livestream![/h3]
Tomorrow there will be a livestream including REAL LIFE prices! Join the discord for more information!
The button to join the discord can be found in the main menu! Hope to see you there!

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Fixed an issue where presets would not load
Fixed a spawn location being in a tree and flinging you out on spawn
Fixed an issue with the “hot potato” gamemode where the bomb times would be inconsistent and unreliable with selected settings

[h3]Give a gift![/h3]
Don’t know what to give your friends on christmas? Make sure to have a peek at our merch store: https://intoxicated-driver.myspreadshop.com/

notes.title: THE PEDESTRIANS UPDATE!
notes.content:
[h1]NEW: Pedestrians gamemode[/h1]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44830981/fd0df5b24cce18267bb3be981eb61fc5095fbe21.png[/img]
[h3]Hit your targeted pedestrian to gain points! The more intoxicated you are the more points you will get![/h3]

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a pedestrian gamemode, the amount of pedestrians is customizable in the gamemode settings
[*] Added a statistic in the career tab for pedestrians hit
[*] Added a special item that will unlock all buyable items
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Cops can now pick up powerups
[*] Added invisible barriers on “Vertigo” so you do not fall at certain parts in the racing gamemode
[*] Joining or rejoining a game of “Cops & Drunks” that is in progress will make you a cop instead of a drunk
[*] Players will join the team with the lowest amount team members in “Capture the Flag”
[*] Some jump pads will no longer spawn in the racing gamemode
[*] The driving sounds should now sound better
[*] The chat should be more visible
[*] Trees are now lower quality to improve performance
[*] The “Fire wrap” displays better on shorter vehicles and with lighter colors equipped
[*] There is now less alcohol on “Vertigo”
[*] There are now icons for “random gamemode” and “random map” options
[*] Improved the “Loop the loop” models to remove shadow artifacts
[*] Fixed the “Space bundle” showing in the store more than it should
[*] Made it so there can’t be the same bundle two times in a row
[*] Moved a “Loop the loop” down on “Snowy Forest” to not block the car approaching it from certain angles
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed alcohol and powerups floating in the sky when there is no bridge on “Floating Islands”
[*] Made it so the input buttons are always capitalized in game
[*] Fixed random gamemode loading gamemodes that are either made for developers or not randomized
[*] Made it so the statistic of how many games you have played only counts up when you have completed a game
[*] Made it so you can’t have the same achievement twice or more times at the same time
[*] Fixed the score of cops being a very large negative number
[*] Fixed challenges that require you to win in specific gamemodes being completed by winning any gamemode
[*] Made it so water on Dunes does not flicker anymore
[*] Made the win tracker count up for every gamemode
[*] Deformation should be less buggy
[*] Fixed an outline appearing in the background of the customization UI
[*] Fixed a clipping material in the dark alley on Vertigo
[*] Fixed some wires not having collision on Vertigo
[*] Fixed distance traveled being an insanely high number
[*] Fixed some bundles not being obtainable
[*] Fixed a bug where you leave with the hot potato attached, your bomb gets passed without adding time
[/list]

notes.title: OUT OF BETA(WOLF)!
notes.content:
[h2]New features:[/h2]
Added a low chance for commands without 'Simon says' in Simon Says mode
There is now a game setting to set the time until explosion in “Hot Potato”

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
Made bomb beeping noise speed up the closer it is to exploding “Hot Potato”
Beeping of timer in simon says is now quieter
You now have more time to complete the “flip upside down” objective in Simon Says
You now lose more when points dying in the lines gamemode
Removed a rock on dunes that would break your fall from the giant peak
Moved some racing spawns on vertigo to prevent clipping
Moved some books on “Giant’s Tower” level to be further apart
“Spin in 3 circles” objective in Simon Says has been changed to “Spin in circles”
Candles on “The world” map now have no collision
Timings of the bomb in “Hot Potato” have been rebalanced
When passing the bomb in “Hot Potato”, the bomb gains +10 points
Moved a fence on “Snowy Forest” to not float anymore
When there are no more drunks in “Cops & Drunks” gamemode due to a playing leaving, the cops will win
Moved some trees that were too close to the front of a loop
Moved some spawns on “Snowy Forest” to no longer be in newly added structures

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Fixed fog not working
Fixed the “Drive 100m” objective in Simon Says not working for clients
Fixed alcohol not spawning on “Snowy Forest”
Fixed a typo in the gamemode settings
Fixed the timer changing to a insanely high time after dying
Removed a random floating plane of “water” on Snowy Forest
Removed your car exploding in the main menu after spawning in another car
Fixed a bug where your cop siren would spawn in the wrong position when wearing certain hats
Fixed players not becoming blue after becoming a cop
Fixed gamemode settings not showing settings for the correct gamemode

Thank you to all players so far <3 this could not have been possible without you and all of our testers and supporters!
We are excited to be delivering you future content!

notes.title: Simon Says Update
notes.content:
[h2]Introducing a new game mode, Simon Says[/h2] 
In Simon Says, you need to complete a random objective within the time limit to gain points! But beware, it gets harder and harder as time goes on.

There currently aren't too many challenges in Simon Says, but we will add more in the near future, so stay tuned! (we just wanted to release the update to get feedback, and improve it shortly after)

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] There are now stats after each match to know how everyone did! (they are really cool)
[*] There is a death log instead of putting them in the chat (so it doesn't get cluttered)
[*] Added an option to turn off CTF overdosing when too drunk
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a flaming hoop to snowy forest
[*] Made the racing easier in magical library by moving the globe higher
[*] Moved the flag spawn of the blue team in dunes
[*] Made all types of being destroyed in hot potato take away the same amount of points
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed scanner not working sometimes
[*] Fixed going to the top of chat history when dying/going to lobby
[*] Fixed a racing spawn in sacred shrine that spawned you in the tires
[*] Fixed plenty of places where through was spelled wrong (oops)
[/list]
Plus as usual, there is more stuff that doesn't really need to be talked about. I hope you love the update as much as we do!

We have a lot planned for the near(ish) future, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Tracks & Dunes Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830981/66d78b69c2c2696d8909f45b70a3113cd44a6923.png[/img]
[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Dunes has been reimagined, the map now features much more content like an oasis, new trees, rocks and better graphics
[*] You now leave a track where you drive, the track moves grass aside and leaves an effect on grass, snow, and sand
[*] Added support wheels, you receive these by clicking the “Join Discord” button, if you are already in the Discord, just click it again and it will grant you the new wheels!
[*] Hot potato update: the person with the bomb now has the ability to scan
[*] Capture the flag update: when you get too drunk while carrying the flag, you will overdose
[*] Daily bundles are now shown in the mainmenu

[/list]
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]

[*] The giant in the small vs large gamemode now takes double the damage!
[*] The menu buttons now have a nicer color, allowing you to differentiate them from the dark backgrounds easier and adding more style
[*] Map names no longer use their development name in Steam and Discord presence
[*] Reworked super damage to be more consistent
[*] In little vs big gamemode, made it say that it is recommended for more people
[*] Made the grass material look better
[*] Improved how timers look in main menu
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the siren of your cop would show up in wrong positions when wearing specific cosmetics
[*] Fixed a bug where if you touch someone in hot potato, the bomb didn’t pass
[*] Fixed map/gamemode saving issue (where it would not remember the last map/gamemode you played)
[*] Fixed some game modes not giving players wins in the lobby
[*] Fixed a glitch where you spawn without wheels
[*] Fixed size of roof in a tower in floating islands/mainmenu
[*] Fixed a bug where the timer went to zero for a second when dying in the racing gamemode
[*] Fixed the timer in racing not stopping after completing a race
[*] Fixed thumbnail rarity of cat ear headphones
[*] If the person holding the bomb destroys themself, they no longer only lose 10 points
[/list]
[h3]Soon To Be Release:[/h3]
We are getting close to fully releasing the game out of beta, so if you have any bugs that you would like to be fixed beforehand, please report them in our discord: https://discord.gg/VRusrUFtqK

notes.title: Achievements and Polish Update
notes.content:
[h1]There's lots of new features, improvements, and bug fixes in this update, so get ready![/h1]

[h2]New features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Player usernames, they appear above the car when you are close to a vehicle (and can see it)
[*] New “fastest time per map” for the racing gamemode
[*] The graphics of the game have been remade entirely
[*] We have added steam achievements (with more to come in the future)
[*] New career tab to visit the leaderboard, see your personal statistics and track your achievements
[*] Your total wins in a session are now visible to anyone in the playerlist
[*] Implemented Discord and Steam rich presence
[*] Made it so when you go through a checkpoint in the racing gamemode, you get a speed boost in the direction you are looking at (the strength is related to speed and look direction)
[*] New option to toggle push to talk
[*] New drunkenness option for all gamemodes
[/list]
[h2]Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a popup when a host leaves the game
[*] Redid map selector UI (looks so much better)
[*] Redid the sand on dunes so it looks less janky (and fixed issue where it was black on low graphics and from far away)
[*] When selecting racing gamemode, the variants on floating islands are hidden
[*] Disabled zooming on the car character when in different menus that also use the scroll wheel
[*] Reverted jump height back to the original height
[*] Added more bundles

notes.title: The Powerups (and much more) Update
notes.content:
[h2]Powerups[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44830981/0270dc42682aae7d683832f66ad5377e8fbb7cc3.png[/img]
We added powerups that you can enable/disable with the game options (under fun settings). There are 7 powerups, with the possibility of more in the future! Also, all the powerups have challenges associated with them. Below are all the powerups with a description of what they do:
[h3]Infinite Boosts[/h3]
This one is pretty explanatory, as you get infinite boosts and less recharge delay between boosts for a short period!
[h3]Super Damage[/h3]
This powerup gives you, and you alone, super damage for a short period of time. This is super useful to take out other alcoholics in the default game mode, or defend your flag in capture the flag (and of course much more).
[h3]Super Honk[/h3]
Probably the most fun powerup, as it allows you to launch any nearby players away from you whenever you honk. Plus, it has a cool looking effect.
[h3]Jump Height[/h3]
This powerup increases your jump height (for a period of time) so you can reach the skies :)
[h3]Shield[/h3]
The shield makes it so the next time you take damage, you don't take any (lasts until you take damage).
[h3]Water[/h3]
This powerup reduces how drunk you are!
[h3]HP[/h3]
This powerup repairs your car so you can survive longer!

[h2]UI Overhaul[/h2]
We completely redid the UI to make it so controllers can work on them while also improving the look/feel! We are happy to say the game (in theory) should fully work with controllers! There may be some bugs and we have some improvements we want to make, but everything should work!

[h2]Alcohol Spawning Overhaul[/h2]
We overhauled how alcohol is spawned so no matter how many players you are playing with, everyone can get drunk! We also increased the overall amount of alcohol throughout the maps to make the game more true to its name :).

[h2]Semi Large Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made it so there is no player collision when spawning!! (this helps a lot)
[*] Overdosing button that allows you to respawn if you are too drunk/stuck somewhere
[*] Added chatting so you can talk with people you aren't in a call with!
[*] You now spawn with max boosts
[*] Added search bar to friends list
[*] Redid gamemode icons
[*] Increased the height of the racing border on dunes so you don't fly over it
[/list]
[h2]Small Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased max public lobby size to 20
[*] Changed map order in map selector so better maps are higher
[*] The drunkenness effect now goes away immediately after you die
[*] Added a host public lobby button to the mainmenu
[*] Redid wording for randomly pick cop option to make it more intuitive
[*] Jumping sounds are quieter
[*] Added a checkpoint sound effect
[*] Added private/public lobby text in both the main menu and server browser to make it more user friendly
[*] Better sound effect for flaming hoops
[*] Made racing checkpoints darker (easier to see)
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Waiting for players text doesnt randomly appear anymore
[*] Magical library checkpoints fixed so you don't fall off the map after spawning
[*] Fixed some landscape issues on Dunes
[*] Fixed some collision issues on all maps
[*] Fixed some checkpoint positions on dunes
[*] Fixed some cosmetic spawn points on the rocket ship
[/list]

[h1]New Maps[/h1]
[h2]Snowy Forest:[/h2]
Snowy forest is a brand new map that places you in a winter wonderland, nestled in the foothills of snow capped peaks. This map is medium size, and is perfectly fit for the new game mode (which is talked about later!)

[h2]Giant’s Tower:[/h2]
Giant’s Tower places you in a tower fit for a giant. With a plethora of objects throughout the map, it is perfect for parkouring and screwing around!

[h2]Future Maps:[/h2]
We have also started working on a new map 👀. It is a very different playing experience from the other maps, so be excited!
We also want to further improve our current maps by adding more details and making them more enjoyable! Expect this to come soon!

[h1]New Gamemode:[/h1]
[h2]Capture the flag[/h2]
In this team based mode you must capture the other’s team flag and deliver it to your flag post, but be quick, the longer you hold the flag, the more intoxicated you get!

Whether you are rushing to steal their flag, or defending your own. Teamwork is key!

[h1]Leveling Rewards[/h1]
You can now get FREE COSMETICS! Just play the game and gather XP to level up, every 10 levels you will receive a new cosmetic.

You can also take on other players in the new leaderboard, compete against all other players to earn the highest spot on the leaderboard! 

Currently we only have a leaderboard for the highest level, but be on the lookout for speedrun times soon 👀

[h1]Improved Performance[/h1]
We had lots of feedback that the performance was suboptimal, and that the GPU would constantly run at 100%. We found that the main culprit was that max FPS was set to 240, meaning the computer would be doing a bunch of extra work if you only needed the game to run at 60 or 120 frames. We fixed this by adding a max FPS setting!

We also greatly improved performance, reducing the scene rendering time by a significant margin. This gave us more room to increase the shadow quality, also improving the aesthetics of the game!

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Removed invisible death barriers on the dunes map, which caused players to “randomly” die.
Teleports now behave normally.
Controller movement now uses dead zones for your joystick.
Fixed the common and uncommon rarity being swapped when hovering over a cosmetic.
Fixed a small typo on the description of the “Lush Forest” map.
Sliders in the options menu will not make the game lag anymore when changing their value.
There are now the correct amount of laps in the racing gamemode (there was one too few before)

notes.content:

- fixed area where you could get stuck between a barrier and a rock on Dunes
- improves barriers so less of them are floating/in ground

- made it so you get slightly less drunk whe ngoing trough checkpoints
- the entire social text and button is now clickable
- when waiting for players in the cops gamemode there is now a text indicating so
- cars no longer block the camera, which fixes a bug when cars are stacked the bottom car would enter a "first person" mode

[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
- Fixed a bug where players would die instantly when respawning at the same checkpoint in the race gamemode by granting temporary invincibility
- Racing gamemode specific gamemode settings now show what option is selected
- sliders in the color picker UI are now much smoother

Super damage now works as intended

Changed texture streaming budget on different graphical settings
